/**
 * MIRA — Return Token Metrics v1.0
 * Returns verified generation usage to the caller.
 */

const usage = $('Resolve Langfuse Trace').first().json;
const otel = $('Build Token OTEL').first().json;
const exportResult = $input.first().json;


const accepted =
  exportResult?.name === 'otel-ingestion-job' &&
  exportResult?.data?.payload?.authCheck?.validKey === true;

return [{
  json: {
    execution_id: usage.execution_id,
    workflow_id: usage.workflow_id,
    trace_id: usage.trace_id,

    test_case_id:
      $('When Executed by Another Workflow')
        .first().json.test_case_id ?? null,

    agent_name:
      $('When Executed by Another Workflow')
        .first().json.agent_name ?? null,

    model:
      usage.model_usage_records?.[0]?.model ?? null,

    generation_input_tokens:
      usage.generation_input_tokens,

    generation_output_tokens:
      usage.generation_output_tokens,

    generation_total_tokens:
      usage.generation_total_tokens,

    model_call_count:
      usage.model_call_count,

    langfuse_export_submitted: accepted,

    langfuse_ingestion_confirmed: false,

    generation_observation_count:
      otel.generation_count
  }
}];
